top_signals.title: IMF Says Saudi Buffers, Energy Backup Blunt Economic Blow
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia’s fiscal buffers and backup oil-export facilities are helping curb the damage to the Middle East’s largest economy from the Iran war, according to the International Monetary Fund.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
